{"action": "write", "path": "slug.py", "content": "import re


def slugify(title):
    """Convert a title into a URL-friendly slug."""
    # 1. lowercase
    s = title.lower()
    # 2. replace each '&' with ' and '
    s = s.replace('&', ' and ')
    # 3. drop every character that is not an ASCII letter, digit, space or hyphen
    s = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9 \-]', '', s)
    # 4. turn each run of spaces and hyphens into one hyphen
    s = re.sub(r'[ \-]+', '-', s)
    # 5. strip hyphens from both ends
    s = s.strip('-')
    # 6. truncate to 40 characters, then strip any trailing hyphen
    if len(s) > 40:
        s = s[:40].rstrip('-')
    return s
